method: Whole-file manual reading of simplified Chinese catalog; pinned bytes reverified; v91 structural evidence retained.
findings: 疑似重复文件 denotes suspected duplicates, 哈希前缀 marks prefix and 采样哈希 marks sampling. Advanced option says sparse hashing for files over64MiB; this does not prove full-content equality.
Recovery completion requests verifying file data, recoverable and possible recovery remain separate, changed source metadata requests rescan and same-source-volume restoration warns of overwrite.
Sparse-file action 文件稀疏压缩 says sparse compression and may conflate sparsification with compression. File-selection tooltip says read disk scan records rather than opening drive selection.
Cloud warning says scanning will trigger download, stronger than the English may-download wording. It still directs users to change settings; runtime hydration prevention is not proven.

Regex setting omits the explicit alternative to glob patterns, and portable-mode text omits exact WinDirStat.ini filename. Treemap caption says tree view, potentially confusing graph with hierarchical list.

Hardlinks/symlinks/junctions, logical/physical sizes and binary units remain distinct. Custom-cleanup fields intact; MSI zh-CN/2052/936 differs from capture neutral resource ID30724, not by itself an error.
limits: No native-speaker certification, Chinese rendered UI, mnemonic conflict, installer encoding or Windows locale/runtime qualification. No foreign production code adopted.
Native pHash investigation deferred; completed repository count remains147/500.
